title: Manyhands JSON v1 preview
description: The data of a prepare envelope that gives a preview of repo create or repo enable: what the command will do, and the confirmation an execute of the same command, repository, target and input presents to do it. A prepare that gives no preview carries no data: a rejection, and a no-op for a command whose end state already holds.

confirmation_id.description: What an execute presents as its consent. It is accepted by one request.

expires_at.description: When the confirmation stops being accepted by a new request: ten minutes after the preview. A request that has accepted it is honored afterwards.

command.description: The command the confirmation is for, as an envelope names it.

effects.description: What the command will do, in the order it does it.

details.description: The command's own fields. For repo create and repo enable: the repository's root, the primary branch, the identity that will author the initialization commit, and the short code prefix.

source.description: Where the identity comes from: supplied with the request, or the level of Git configuration that holds it.

written_locally.description: Whether the command writes the identity to the repository's own Git configuration. No other configuration is written.

slug_prefix.description: The short code prefix the configuration will hold. Null when the request supplies none.
